virals_narrative: Codie Sanchez dominated again: the paper-mail story reached 92.4K, 'You win in business by being ok with people...' 53.4K in about 10 hours, and her Guillermo Rauch AI list 44.9K. Arvid Kahl's 'they sell stability' post reached 39.3K, Tony Dinh's software-factory prediction 22.8K, and Shopify's Shop Pay on Muse post 12.6K. Square posted one original under 5K; Pat Walls posted none. No niche vendor post cleared 5K; artist alley table prices ($600-$800) were the loudest vendor topic overnight. Competitors HipopMarkets, BoothKeeper and BuildersBenchRe posted nothing in the window.
